name: chatarv
description: Run real estate comps, read comp reports and estimate repair costs from your ChatARV account.

interface.longDescription:
ChatARV values residential real estate for investors, wholesalers and agents. Give it a US property address and it finds comparable recent sales, adjusts them against the subject property, and reports an after-repair value (ARV) with a confidence rating and the top comps with photos.

With ChatARV in ChatGPT you can:
- Run comps on an address, with optional square footage, beds, baths, property type and custom search instructions
- Revise a report's comps with a different search radius, square footage range, property type or valuation method
- List and open your saved comp reports
- View photos of the subject property or any of its comps
- Estimate repair costs by category from a description of the subject property's condition
- Check your account details

Limitations: ChatARV covers US properties only and requires a ChatARV account. Reports created in ChatGPT are saved to that account, and each comp run counts toward the account's monthly comp limit. A comp run usually takes 30 to 90 seconds.
defaultPrompt: Run comps on a property and tell me its after-repair value.
Show my most recent comp reports.
Estimate repairs for my latest comp report.

positive.description: Run comps on a US address
positive.prompt: Run comps on 3012 Talisman Rd, Louisville, KY 40220 and tell me the after-repair value.
positive.expected_behavior: After 30 to 90 seconds, returns the subject property's details, an after-repair value with a confidence rating, and the top comparable sales with photos. The report is saved to the test account with a report ID.

positive.prompt: Show me my most recent comp reports.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's comp reports, newest first, with each report's address, after-repair value and confidence.

positive.description: Open and summarize a saved report
positive.prompt: Open my most recent comp report and summarize the after-repair value and the comps it used.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the newest report and summarizes its after-repair value, confidence and top comparable sales, with photos.

positive.prompt: Re-run comps on my most recent report using only comps within 1.5 miles.
positive.expected_behavior: Re-runs the comp search for that report with a 1.5-mile radius and returns the new version's after-repair value and comps. The new version is saved alongside the original report.

positive.description: Estimate repair costs for a report
positive.prompt: Estimate repairs for my most recent comp report. The roof needs replacing and the kitchen is original.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a repair cost breakdown by category, including the roof and kitchen, with a total. The estimate is saved to the report and becomes its estimated repair cost.

negative.description: Purchases are out of scope. The plugin has no tool that changes a plan or takes payment, so it should say it cannot do this and start no checkout.
negative.prompt: Upgrade my ChatARV plan so I can run more comps this month.

negative.description: Deleting reports is not supported. No tool deletes a report, so the plugin should say it cannot delete reports and change nothing.
negative.prompt: Delete all of my comp reports.

negative.description: Reports belonging to other accounts are not accessible. get_comp_report refuses a report the test account does not own, so no data from another account is shown.

review.commerce_description: ChatARV does not sell anything or process payments in ChatGPT. Users sign in to an existing ChatARV account.

publication.release_notes: ChatARV is now available to ChatGPT users in every country. Comps still cover US properties only.
